item.title: FREE Açai Bowls, Ice Cream & Gashapon @ Youth Action Expo 2026
item.description: Hey Hwa Chong! Looking for something fun to do on 16 March? Head down to *Youth Action Expo 2026 @ *SCAPE (12:30 - 3:30 PM) and check out: 🎁 FREE Gashapon rewards 🍦 FREE açai bowl or ice cream (first 400 participants) 📸 FREE photobooth + live caricature artists 🎯 Youth Action Playground with carnival games (cup pong, dartboard, reaction time booth & more) 🧠 Interactive youth exhibition with organisations like Temasek Foundation, NYC, SKM, Beyond Social Services, Alexandra Hospital & NEA 📍 *SCAPE, 2 Orchard Link 📅 16 March | 12:30–3:30 PM The Expo brings together youths and organisations across Singapore to show how service learning can go beyond school VIA and become real youth-led impact. Bring your friends and come explore 👀 See you there! Warm regards, Spin Up

item.title: 5 Vacancies for tomorrow - Bluetooth Speaker!
item.description: 5 vacancies for anyone who is available and interested! Bluetooth Speaker Workshop! 📅 Tuesday, 10 March ⏰ 2:30 PM – 4:30 PM 📍Science & Research Centre, Engineering Lab, R117 Come and join us to build your Bluetooth speaker! Register for the workshop/s in this google link : https://forms.gle/ELVga6aWPo9wPSjC9 Please be on time so we can start creating together. _______________________________________________________________________ Dear Students, On top of the usual Makerspace@B102 opening hours i.e. Tuesdays 230pm to 430pm, Odd Thursdays, 8am - 1130 Even Thursdays, 8am – 945am & 230pm to 430pm we have a series of passion-in-making activities planned for you! Coming T1 Workshops A. 9 February, Monday, 1430 – 1630, Media Controller (NEW!) B. 24 February, Tuesday, 1430 – 1630, Game Controller C. 3 March, Tuesday, 1430 – 1630, MacroPad D. 9 March, Monday, 1430 –1630, Desktop Companion (NEW!) E. 10 March, Tuesday, 1430 –1630, Bluetooth Speaker Register for the workshop/s in this google link : https://forms.gle/ELVga6aWPo9wPSjC9 Act soon before the workshops are fully booked. Do find some time to complete the online module MC01 https://goo.gl/forms/1fG5mrS5TalCYLrr1 which is the prerequisite before using the Makerspace if you have not done so before. Drop by or visit us at https://sites.google.com/hci.edu.sg/hcimakereducation/home for more information! Brought to you by, Makerspace Team
